decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the Greasefang Parhelion combo as quickly as possible, utilizing cards like Professor of Symbology and Formidable Speaker to tutor for pieces and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Collective Brutality and Cache Grab for additional interaction and resource management. The goal is to generate value through token generation with Esika's Chariot and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats like Parhelion II and Overlord of the Balemurk. The deck aims to control the board and win through a game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, card draw, and removal spells. By using cards like Divide by Zero and Abandon Attachments to disrupt your opponent's strategy, while setting up powerful card advantage with Tablet of Discovery and Jeskai Revelation. Firebending Lesson and Combustion Technique provide removal options, while Accumulate Wisdom helps dig for key pieces. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Thor, God of Thunder to close out the game. With a mix of control and card advantage, this deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of creature cards with powerful abilities to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By efficiently ramping up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, the player can play high-impact creatures like Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu and Skyclave Apparition early on. Collected Company allows for more creatures to be put into play at once, while cards like Selfless Spirit and Enduring Vitality provide protection and resilience to ensure the creatures can deal maximum damage to the opponent before they can respond.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays using low-cost spells and creatures. By utilizing cards like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Burst Lightning, you can apply pressure early in the game. Cards like Boomerang Basics and Reckless Rage can help with removal and disruption, while Flow State and Stormchaser's Talent provide additional card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to maintain a fast pace and control the board through a combination of efficient creatures and powerful instant spells.

The deck focuses on setting up a powerful token-generating engine with Greasefang, Okiba Boss and utilizing cards like Esper Origins and Parhelion II to create a high number of tokens quickly. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize for disruption and protection, as well as additional creature threats like Overlord of the Balemurk. By combining token generation with efficient removal and disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a large army of creatures while controlling the game state.

This aggro red deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays like Monastery Swiftspear and Emberheart Challenger, with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the way for damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Kumano Faces Kakkazan for additional creature power. The inclusion of lands like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins provide extra reach and damage options, solidifying the deck's strategy of relentless aggression and pressure.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. It also utilizes the companion mechanic with Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional card advantage. The deck aims to maintain board control through cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Supreme Verdict, while also setting up for powerful late game plays with Beza, the Bounding Spring and March of Otherworldly Light. Overall, the deck prioritizes card advantage, board control, and disruption to outlast and outplay opponents in a slower, more controlling style of play.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. With a high land count and the option to play Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion for extra value, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent through superior card advantage and board control. The key strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition, utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and a variety of utility lands to supplement its game plan.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Emberheart Challenger, Soul-Scar Mage, and efficient burn spells like Reckless Rage, Burst Lightning, and Monstrous Rage. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent through tempo advantage and card advantage with cards like Academic Dispute, Sleight of Hand, and Stormchaser's Talent. The mana base is designed for fast and consistent casting of spells, with efficient lands like Steam Vents, Spirebluff Canal, and Riverglide Pathway.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive cards. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while generating card advantage with effects like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also aims to outvalue the opponent through the use of Yorion, Sky Nomad and bounce effects like Boomerang Basics. By creating a resource advantage and disrupting the opponent's plans, the deck aims to take control of the game and secure a victory.

The main focus of this UR Aggro Pioneer deck is to consistently deal damage quickly and efficiently to the opponent using low-cost spells and creatures with prowess abilities. By utilizing cards like Soul-Scar Mage, Monastery Swiftspear, and Emberheart Challenger along with burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain momentum throughout the game. The inclusion of card draw and mana fixing cards like Sleight of Hand and Multiversal Passage helps ensure the deck can consistently execute its game plan.

The primary focus of this Dimir Control deck is to maintain control of the game through disruption and removal spells, while also utilizing card advantage and tempo plays. The deck aims to outvalue opponents by utilizing cards like Narset, Parter of Veils and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's resources, while also having access to powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Stock Up. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value and flexibility in the deck, making it a versatile and potent control archetype.

This Golgari Aggro deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and utilizing efficient creatures like Badgermole Cub, Elvish Mystic, and Llanowar Elves to overwhelm the opponent. Key creatures like Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler and Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu provide additional aggression and synergy with Nature's Rhythm. Enduring Vitality and Fiend Artisan help to maintain board presence and provide flexibility in combat situations. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy. By utilizing efficient creatures like Badgermole Cub and Ouroboroid along with mana acceleration from Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck can quickly establish a board presence. Collected Company allows for explosive creature plays, while cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben disrupt the opponent's game plan. Skyclave Apparition provides removal for problematic creatures, while Enduring Innocence offers protection for your own creatures. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain aggression throughout the game.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck in Pioneer format is to maintain control of the game by utilizing a combination of counter spells, card draw, and removal. By using cards like Divide by Zero and Combustion Technique to control the opponent's board, and cards like Pop Quiz and Tablet of Discovery to draw into more resources, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents while keeping the board under control. With a mix of removal, card draw, and finishers like Thor, God of Thunder, this deck looks to control the pace of the game and secure victory.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Emberheart Challenger, while utilizing spells like Burst Lightning, Reckless Rage, and Stormchaser's Talent to control the board and deal direct damage. The deck also includes card draw and mana fixing elements like Sleight of Hand and Riverpyre Verge to maintain tempo and consistency. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build up a threatening board presence and finish off the opponent with a mix of creature and burn spells.
